1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal addition to compressor systems and ensures a stable pressure supply for air and gas applications. Available in pressure stages of 330 bar and 420 bar, it reduces pressure fluctuations during peak demand and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.: Storage cylinder with console
A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.: Pressure vessel
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.: Condensate drain
Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.: Options
Safety valve and pressure gauge: Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.
The storage design: Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation
A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.: To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.
The size of the storage system depends on:: Compressor delivery rate (l/min)
Air consumption of the specific application: Pressure differential between start and stop (hysteresis)
Simplified formula for sizing a high-pressure storage system (based on 4 load cycles/hour):: Vk (l/min): Compressor delivery volume in liters per minute
V (l): Storage volume in liters (water volume): Δp (bar): Pressure differential (hysteresis) in bar
We recommend a pressure differential Δp of max. 60 bar for continuous operation. Within this range, stationary high-pressure storage cylinders are typically rated for continuous duty. For higher differentials, the number of allowable filling cycles is limited. Please refer to the documentation for the specific pressure vessel.: Downloads

Purification System P 41
The P 41
Purification System
with additional oil and water separator as well as pressure-retaining non-return valve ensures reliable breathing air in accordance with DIN EN 12021:2014¹ when using original BAUER filter cartridges. External signal transmitters can be connected at any time, and operation in a networked system or with an external display is also possible.

Integrated gas measurement system B-DETECTION PLUS i
The integrated B-DETECTION PLUS gas measurement system monitors breathing air and Nitrox in real time according to DIN EN 12021:2014. It measures CO, CO₂, O₂, humidity, and VOCs, and protects with automatic shutdown in case of limit exceedance. The CO ping test checks sensors before start. With B-CLOUD, digital documentation and remote access are possible. Optionally, contaminated air can be vented automatically outdoors.
B-SECURUS filter monitoring
The B-SECURUS system monitors the saturation of the filter cartridge(s) by measuring the moisture level in the molecular sieve and provides a timely indication when a cartridge replacement is required – either on the display or via the control unit. Once saturation is reached, the system automatically shuts down the unit. The B-SECURUS filter monitoring system can only be used in conjunction with the P 41, P 61, or P 81

In combination with additional filling panels, the MAXI filling panel is ideally suited for setting up a filling line with an alternative filling pressure (e.g., additional MIDI filling panels with 300 and 200 bar).
The filling pressure in the pressure vessel is displayed via a pressure gauge in bar/psi.
Details & Features
The B-MASTER MINI, MIDI, and MAXI filling panels are purpose-built for the filling of compressed air cylinders used in paintball sports. They enable safe and efficient filling of bottles ranging from 0.8 to 1.9 liters at 200 or 300 bar. The system is designed for external mounting and can be expanded using T-pieces – ideal for multi-table setups.
The rugged filling coupling with integrated check valve fits all standard paintball nipples and prevents the hose from whipping if triggered without a connected marker. An integrated silencer reduces noise when venting the hose.

Monitoring of intermediate pressures and intermediate stage temperatures
This monitoring system is ideal for continuous or fully automatic operation, as well as for systems without constant specialist supervision. If defined limit values are exceeded or undershot, an automatic shutdown is triggered. The current actual values are displayed in the B-CONTROL compressor control system.
Oil level monitoring
When the minimum oil level mark is reached, a warning message appears in the control system. This option is particularly recommended for continuous operation and increases the operational safety of the compressor system by providing early information about critical fill levels.
Particle filter
An integrated particle filter is optionally available in combination with the P 41, P 61, and P 81 purification systems, ensuring consistently high purity levels.

Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation

To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.

A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.

Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.

A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.

Integrated gas measurement system B-DETECTION PLUS i
The integrated B-DETECTION PLUS gas measurement system monitors breathing air and Nitrox in real time according to DIN EN 12021:2014. It measures CO, CO₂, O₂, humidity, and VOCs, and protects with automatic shutdown in case of limit exceedance. The CO ping test checks sensors before start. With B-CLOUD, digital documentation and remote access are possible. Optionally, contaminated air can be vented automatically outdoors.
B-SECURUS filter monitoring
The B-SECURUS system monitors the saturation of the filter cartridge(s) by measuring the moisture level in the molecular sieve and provides a timely indication when a cartridge replacement is required – either on the display or via the control unit. Once saturation is reached, the system automatically shuts down the unit. The B-SECURUS filter monitoring system can only be used in conjunction with the P 41, P 61, or P 81

Details & Features
The B-MASTER MINI, MIDI, and MAXI filling panels are purpose-built for the filling of compressed air cylinders used in paintball sports. They enable safe and efficient filling of bottles ranging from 0.8 to 1.9 liters at 200 or 300 bar. The system is designed for external mounting and can be expanded using T-pieces – ideal for multi-table setups.
The rugged filling coupling with integrated check valve fits all standard paintball nipples and prevents the hose from whipping if triggered without a connected marker. An integrated silencer reduces noise when venting the hose.

Monitoring of intermediate pressures and intermediate stage temperatures
This monitoring system is ideal for continuous or fully automatic operation, as well as for systems without constant specialist supervision. If defined limit values are exceeded or undershot, an automatic shutdown is triggered. The current actual values are displayed in the B-CONTROL compressor control system.
Oil level monitoring
When the minimum oil level mark is reached, a warning message appears in the control system. This option is particularly recommended for continuous operation and increases the operational safety of the compressor system by providing early information about critical fill levels.

An integrated particle filter is optionally available in combination with the P 41, P 61, and P 81 purification systems, ensuring consistently high purity levels.
